name: Body Of Christ
overview: The Scriptures reveal the Church as the Body of Christ, united under Christ as its head, who holds preeminence over all (Colossians 1:18). Believers are many members with diverse roles, yet they are one body, intimately connected and dependent on one another (Romans 12:4-5). This body is perfected, equipped for ministry, and built up in love through the effective working of every part joined together (Ephesians 4:12,16). Ultimately, the Body of Christ embodies the fullness of Christ Himself, who fills all in all (Ephesians 1:23).
